description: This source file contains a suite of smoke tests for the OnboardingView component in a SwiftUI-based macOS application. The tests verify the behavior of the onboarding view's UI elements, page order logic, and gateway selection handling.

classes.name: OnboardingViewSmokeTests
classes.description: A test suite for the OnboardingView component, including multiple test cases for UI and gateway selection behaviors.

methods.name: `onboarding view builds body`
methods.description: Test that the onboarding view can successfully build its body content without errors.

methods.name: `page order omits workspace and identity steps`
methods.description: Test that the page order excludes workspace and identity steps based on certain conditions.

methods.name: `page order omits onboarding chat when identity known`
methods.description: Test that the onboarding chat page is omitted when the identity is already known.

methods.name: `select remote gateway clears stale ssh target when endpoint unresolved`
methods.description: Test that selecting a remote gateway correctly clears the SSH target when the endpoint is unresolved.
